meta.name: brand-guidelines
meta.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

copy.tagline: 为内容套用品牌色彩与排版规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速为文档或界面应用品牌视觉风格。
copy.tagline_en: Apply brand colors and typography to your content.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly apply brand visual style to documents or interfaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 当你在对话中创建或编辑文档、演示文稿等内容时，Claude 会自动应用 Anthropic 官方品牌颜色（如深色、浅色、橙色等）和字体（标题用 Poppins，正文用 Lora），让内容具有 Anthropic 的视觉风格。
howto.when: 当你需要为内容添加品牌色彩、样式指南或公司设计标准时触发，例如制作带有 Anthropic 风格的幻灯片或文档。

say.text: 帮我做一个 Anthropic 风格的演示文稿封面。
say.note: Claude 会应用品牌颜色和字体生成封面。

say.text: 给这段文字加上 Anthropic 的品牌配色。
say.note: Claude 会调整文字颜色和背景。

howto.what_en: When you create or edit documents, presentations, or other artifacts in conversation, Claude automatically applies Anthropic's official brand colors (e.g., dark, light, orange) and typography (Poppins for headings, Lora for body text) to give the content an Anthropic visual identity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to apply brand colors, style guidelines, or company design standards, such as creating a presentation with Anthropic's look-and-feel.

say_en.note: Claude will apply brand colors and fonts.

say_en.text: Apply Anthropic brand colors to this text.
say_en.note: Claude will adjust text and background colors.
